q: How do I work out CO2 per tonne of washed coal at a Dhanbad washery?
title: Dhanbad washery: CO2 per tonne of washed coal
short: Add the washery's electricity in kWh times the grid factor, 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25 on CEA v21.0, to diesel for loaders and trucks at 2.68 kg per litre. Divide by tonnes of clean coal dispatched, not raw coal fed, because buyers ask per tonne they receive.
audience: Coal washeries in Dhanbad and Jharia supplying coking coal to steel plants

ul: Raw coal received and clean coal dispatched, in tonnes.

p: Washing splits coal into clean coal, middlings and rejects. If middlings go to a power plant as a product, share the washery's emissions by mass or by energy and say which.
The mill adds your figure to mining and freight for its coking coal. It is small next to the coke ovens, but buyers asking for supplier data want it measured, not guessed.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity, diesel and dispatch invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so each figure you send a buyer traces back to the documents behind it.
